issues.legal_issue: The market value for compensation in an acquisition under a local improvement law is determined as of the local notice that serves the same purpose as the general preliminary acquisition notice, under the compensation procedure in force when the acquisition proceedings began.
material_facts: The acquisition proceeded under a local improvement law that applied the general acquisition law except where the local law provided otherwise.
The local law's preliminary notification was published in 1965, before a later declaration under that law.
The general acquisition law's compensation procedure had been amended in 1927 to use the date of its preliminary notification, rather than the date of its later declaration, as the valuation date.
The High Court used the date of the later local declaration, following an earlier ruling that applied the unamended procedure.
issues.conclusion: The valuation date was the date of the local preliminary notification, which served the same purpose as the general preliminary notification. The High Court's judgment was set aside and the case remanded for determination of market value on that basis.
issues.legal_principle: Section 23 of the City of Mysore Improvement Act applied the Land Acquisition Act's procedure, as it stood when acquisition proceedings began, except where the local Act expressly deviated from it. Section 23(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended in 1927, made the general preliminary-notification date the valuation date; under section 6 of the Mysore General Clauses Act, only proceedings commenced before repeal would remain governed by the former procedure. The local preliminary notification served the same purpose as a notification under section 4(1) of the Land Acquisition Act, so its date governed valuation. The Court followed Land Acquisition Officer, City Improvement Trust Board v. H. Narayanaiah and overruled Venkatamma v. Special Land Acquisition Officer.

rule.if: compensation_valuation_appeal and acquisition_under_local_improvement_law and local_law_adopts_general_acquisition_procedure and not local_law_expressly_preserves_old_valuation_rule and current_general_procedure_uses_preliminary_notice and local_preliminary_notice_has_same_purpose

predicates.compensation_valuation_appeal: The proceeding is an appeal concerning the date used to value property for compensation in a compulsory acquisition.
predicates.acquisition_under_local_improvement_law: The property was acquired under a local law providing for an improvement scheme.
predicates.local_law_adopts_general_acquisition_pro: The local law directs that acquisition follow the general acquisition procedure except where the local law provides otherwise.
predicates.local_law_expressly_preserves_old_valuat: The local law expressly retains a valuation rule that has been replaced in the general acquisition procedure.
predicates.current_general_procedure_uses_prelimina: When the acquisition proceedings began, the general procedure used the date of its preliminary notice to determine market value.
predicates.local_preliminary_notice_has_same_purpos: The preliminary notice under the local law served the same purpose as the preliminary notice under the general procedure.

issues.definition: When an appeal concerns compensation valuation for an acquisition under an improvement law that adopts the current general procedure, has no express rule retaining the former valuation date, and uses a preliminary notice serving the same purpose as the general preliminary notice, the value is determined as of the local preliminary notice.
